04 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PRECISION

Technical by training.
Considered by nature.

I’m Erfan Mohiti, a maxillofacial prosthesis designer at Farin Roshaan.

Across more than 400 patient cases, my work has connected digital planning with the demands of implant design, surgical guides and production. My focus is simple: understand the individual, then design with intention.
